entries.zh: 求借；借来花用
entries.en: to ask for a loan; to borrow for spending
entries.notes: 汉字仅'荷'一字而对应两音节，疑为音借字或有脱字，释义依西栏'求借以花用'。

entries.zh: 恳切索求；催逼求给
entries.en: to ask urgently / pressingly; to press for a thing to be given
entries.notes: 西栏'reciñendo'（紧迫催逼义）为罕用形式，'给'字此处作'求给、索予'解系依语境推断。

entries.zh: 求助；祈求护佑
entries.en: to ask for help; to call for aid and protection
entries.notes: 汉字'衍/衛'存疑，原稿音读更近'護'且另有'祈＋护'连读，释义从西栏'求援'之义。

entries.zh: 禀；禀请（向上请求许可）
entries.en: to petition (a superior); to request permission or leave

entries.zh: 禀命；请命于上（请求指示或许可）
entries.en: to ask for orders or permission from one's superior

entries.zh: 谨禀；敬谨禀告（谓言说并诵读所议定之事）
entries.en: to report respectfully; to speak and read out a matter agreed upon

entries.zh: 紧迫恳求；苦苦催迫
entries.en: to importune; to press a request urgently

entries.zh: 补礼；赔礼（具礼谢罪求恕）
entries.en: to make amends with a courtesy gift; to apologize and ask pardon

entries.zh: 回；答话谢罪（原字'目/回'存疑）
entries.en: to reply / make a return (in asking pardon); character uncertain (目/回)
entries.notes: 汉字'目/回'存疑，原稿音与'回'相合，故从'回'释义，谓答话谢罪以求恕。

entries.zh: 化缘；募化（乞求布施）
entries.en: to solicit alms; to beg for charitable donations

entries.zh: 教化；本义教导化育，此处疑取劝募化缘之义
entries.en: to instruct and edify; here glossing 'to beg alms' (probably in the sense of soliciting donations)
entries.notes: 汉字'教化'本义为教导化育，与西栏'乞求布施'不直接相合，或取僧道劝募化缘之义，存疑待考。

entries.zh: 告禀；禀告请求（告求之意）
entries.en: to petition; to report and request (of a superior)

entries.zh: 祈求；向神祷告求助
entries.en: to pray; to entreat (God) for help

entries.zh: 祈祝；祷祝（向神祈祷祝告）
entries.en: to pray and invoke; to offer prayers to God

entries.zh: 苦告；身处困苦而哀告求助
entries.en: to plead bitterly for help in distress; to cry for aid in tribulation

entries.zh: 求救护；危难中呼救求护
entries.en: to cry for rescue and protection; to call for help in distress
entries.notes: 首字'求/斗'存疑，原稿音前后两字读近'求、救'，与'救護'连读相合，故从'求救護'释义。

entries.zh: 手钱；索讨欠款（索回应得之现钱）
entries.en: to demand the money owed to one ('hand-money', cash due)

entries.zh: 顶头；索价超出原价、抬价（据西栏）
entries.en: to ask more than the (agreed) price; to demand a higher price
entries.notes: 西栏'mas dal precio'当为'mas del precio'（索价超出原价）之讹，汉字'顶头'与之对应依赖推断，存疑。

entries.zh: 讨谢礼；索取服役之酬谢
entries.en: to ask payment for one's service; to demand one's reward (thanks-money)
entries.notes: 首字'讨/计'存疑，原稿音与'讨'相合，释义从西栏'索取服役酬谢'。

entries.zh: 讨债；索还欠款（西栏谓请求官府发令拘捕或查检）
entries.en: to collect a debt; to demand repayment (Spanish adds: asking a warrant to arrest or inspect)
entries.notes: 首字'讨/计'存疑，且西栏为'请求官府拘捕或查检之令状'，与'讨债'义相承，释义兼取两者。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字栏与官话栏皆空，闽南原稿音未能对应明确字词，仅西栏'向神祈求'可用，故降为存疑。
